_meta.description: The portal service account's grant (ADR-037 fragment). Every customer-portal request is a PublicPage, so OpenRegister sees Anonymous. Portal writes run as one Nextcloud account an admin picks (PortalServiceAccount), with OpenRegister's checks on. These five schemas grant that account's group, pipelinq-portal-service, create and update, and nobody read or delete: an ordinary logged-in user can no longer see or change a portal account, a session token hash or the audit trail. Admins keep access through OpenRegister's admin bypass. The portal reads its own register with RBAC off and scopes every read by tenant and account itself. The repair step CreatePortalServiceGroup creates the group.
